translation_en: what is this?
how are you doing? (to male)
how are you doing? (to female)
how are you all doing?
how are you, my friend?
how are you, gorgeous?
what's the news? / how's it going?
how are things with you? (to male)
everything is great
praise be to God, I'm doing well
no problem at all
there is no problem whatsoever
good morning
morning of jasmine (warm Egyptian reply)
morning of jasmine
morning of cream (cheerful Masri greeting)
good evening
evening of light (reply)
good night (to male)
and may you be among the people of goodness (reply)
may you be well every year (happy birthday / holiday)

translit: wenta tayyeb we bese77a we salama
wenta tayeb we bise7a we salama
translation_en: and may you be well and in health and peace
you have lit up Egypt (welcome)
make yourself at home (the house is your house)
that is your own light, boss (polite reply)
bless your hands (thank you for food/work)
bless you, my dear friend
may God preserve you (thank you)
may God honor you
may God protect your path
may the same happy occasion happen for you
a thousand congratulations, groom
I want a medium-sugar Turkish coffee
I want mint tea (f)
bring me a glass of cold water
the bill, please
how much is this, please?
it's way too expensive like this
can you lower the price a bit?
what is your final price?
keep the change for yourself
I have small change
I don't have any small change at all
the food tastes really awesome
I am very hungry
let's eat koshary today
breakfast is ready on the table
come let's sit at the coffeehouse
I want to order sugarcane juice
where is the nearest metro station?
how do I get to Tahrir Square?

arabic: إِمْشِي عَلَى طُول وَبَعْدِين حَوِّد يَمِين
arabic_plain: امشي على طول وبعدين حود يمين
translation_en: walk straight ahead and then turn right

translit: 3ala eedak el shimal gamb el kubri
translation_en: on your left hand side next to the bridge

arabic: نَزِّلْنِي هِنَا عَلَى جَنْب يَا أُسْطَى
arabic_plain: نزلني هنا على جنب يا أسطى
translation_en: drop me off here on the side, driver

arabic: عَلَى جَنْب يَا أُسْطَى لَوْ سَمَحْت
arabic_plain: على جنب يا أسطى لو سمحت
translation_en: pull over to the side please, driver
it is super crowded/jammed in the street
the bridge traffic is completely at a standstill right now
I am on my way right now
I have five minutes left and I'll arrive
the car broke down in the middle of the road
where are you going right now?

translit: ana ragi3 el beit ba3d el shughl
translation_en: I am heading back home after work
wait for me in front of the door
I am standing downstairs by the building

translit: itla3 fel asanseer lel dor el rabe3
translation_en: come up in the elevator to the fourth floor
tell you what, my friend / listen up
are you speaking seriously or joking?
I swear I'm not joking with you
you are very funny / charming
stop talking nonsense now

translit: eih el kalam el fady dah
translation_en: what is this nonsense?
don't be upset with me, my bad
there are no hard feelings between brothers
I missed you so much, my dear
I missed you very much too
we haven't seen you in a long time

arabic: فِينَك يَا عَمّ مِش بَايِن لِيه
arabic_plain: فينك يا عم مش باين ليه
translation_en: where have you been, man, why haven't you been around?

arabic: كُنْت مَشْغُول فِي الشُّغْل طُول الأُسْبُوع
arabic_plain: كنت مشغول في الشغل طول الأسبوع
translit: kont mashghool fi el-shoghl tool el-2osboo3
kunt mash8ool fel shughl tul el osboo3
translation_en: I was busy at work all week
we want to meet up soon

translit: eih ra'yak no5rog el gom3a el gaya
translation_en: what do you think about going out next Friday?
awesome idea, let's go!
let's go so we don't get late
please don't be late for me
take care of yourself (to male)
call me when you get home
the phone battery died
do you have a phone charger?
the internet is very weak today
send me the address on WhatsApp
the weather is very hot today
the weather is cold at night
turn on the air conditioner, please
open the window to let some air in
close the door behind you
the power went out in the whole street
thank God the power finally came back
I am tired and want to sleep
I've had a bad headache since morning
wishing you a thousand mercies / get well soon
may God keep you safe, my dear
do you understand what I mean?
yes, I understand you very well

arabic: لَا وَاللهِ مَا أَعْرَفْش حَاجَة عَن المَوْضُوع دَه
arabic_plain: لا والله ما أعرفش حاجة عن الموضوع ده
translit: la wallahy ma a3rafsh 7aga 3an el mawdu3 dah
translation_en: no, honestly I don't know anything about this matter

arabic: مَا تِشْغِلْش بَالَك كُلُّه هَيِبْقَى تَمَام
arabic_plain: ما تشغلش بالك كله هيبقى تمام
translit: ma teshghelsh balak kolloh hayeb2a tamam
ma tish8ilsh balak kollo hayib2a tamam
translation_en: don't worry your mind, everything will be fine
leave it to God
it has truly been a long time, O Egypt
sitting by the Nile at night is irreplaceable
goodness gracious, what beauty!
what is all this sweetness/elegance?

translit: inta insan gada3 w ibn usul
translation_en: you are a stand-up person from a good family

arabic: مَاتْش الكُورَة النَّهَارْدَة كَان حَمَاسِي جِدًّا
arabic_plain: ماتش الكورة النهاردة كان حماسي جدا
translit: match el kora ennaharda kan 7amasy giddan
translation_en: today's football match was very exciting

arabic: جَاب جُون جَامِد فِي آخِر دَقِيقَة
arabic_plain: جاب جون جامد في آخر دقيقة
translit: gaab gon gamed fi a5er da2i2a
translation_en: he scored an awesome goal in the last minute

translit: el sha2a el gedida was3a w mnawara
translation_en: the new apartment is spacious and bright
put the things inside the refrigerator
who is knocking on the door?
please come in, don't be shy
drink a cold beverage first

arabic: أَنَا لِسَّة صَاحِي مِن النُّوم دِلْوَقْتِي
arabic_plain: أنا لسة صاحي من النوم دلوقتي
translit: ana lissa sa7y min el nom delwa2ti
translation_en: I just woke up from sleep right now

translit: lazim as7a badry bukra el sub7
translation_en: I have to wake up early tomorrow morning
I thought you had traveled to Alexandria

translit: la lissa hasafir el osboo3 el gayy
translation_en: no, I will travel next week

arabic: تْرُوح وَتِرْجَع بِالسَّلَامَة إِن شَاء الله
arabic_plain: تروح وترجع بالسلامة إن شاء الله
translit: teroo7 we terga3 bel-salama en sha2 allah
translation_en: may you go and return safely, God willing

arabic: سَلِّم لِي عَلَى أَهْل البِيت كُلُّهُم
arabic_plain: سلم لي على أهل البيت كلهم
translit: sallim lee 3ala ahl el beit kulluhum
translation_en: give my regards to everyone in the family

arabic: يِوْصَل إِن شَاء الله يَا حَبِيب قَلْبِي
arabic_plain: يوصل إن شاء الله يا حبيب قلبي
translation_en: it will be conveyed God willing, my sweetheart
what exactly do you want to say?
I want to tell you that I'm happy to know you

translit: el sharaf liyya ana ya basha
translation_en: the honor is mine, boss

arabic: مَا تِنْسَاش تِجِيب عِيش سُخْن وَإِنْتَ جَايّ
arabic_plain: ما تنساش تجيب عيش سخن وانت جاي
translit: ma tensash tegeeb 3eesh sokhn wenta gay
ma tinsash tigib 3ish so5n wenta gayy
translation_en: don't forget to bring hot bread on your way back
gladly, with my two eyes (at your service)
bless your eyes, my dear
how are you boss, how are you doing?
I want to go to downtown Cairo
where is Ramses Station, please?

translit: 5od el metro asra3 min el taxi
translation_en: take the metro, it's faster than a taxi

translit: el ogra kaam li7ad masr el gedida
translation_en: how much is the fare to Heliopolis?

arabic: إِفْتَح العَدَّاد لَوْ سَمَحْت يَا أُسْطَى
arabic_plain: افتح العداد لو سمحت يا أسطى
translit: ifta7 el 3addad law sama7t ya osta
translation_en: turn on the meter please, driver

arabic: لِسَّة بَدْرِي خَلِّيك قَاعِد مَعَانَا شْوَيَّة
arabic_plain: لسة بدري خليك قاعد معانا شوية
translation_en: it's still early, stay sitting with us a bit
honestly I have work early tomorrow

arabic: تَعَالَى نِتْغَدَّى سَوَا بُكْرَة بَعْد الشُّغْل
arabic_plain: تعالى نتغدى سوا بكرة بعد الشغل
translit: ta3ala netghadda sawa bokra ba3d el-shoghl
ta3ala nit8adda sawa bukra ba3d el shughl
translation_en: come let's have lunch together tomorrow after work
alright we agreed, I'll wait for you at five o'clock

translit: ma tit2a5arsh ashan el mat3am biyiz7am
translation_en: don't be late because the restaurant gets crowded
we want to have hot fava beans and falafel for breakfast
this tea is made just to my liking

translit: el-2ahwa di weshshaha te2eel we gamed
el ahwa dee wishaha ti2eel w gamed
translation_en: this coffee has a thick and awesome crema

arabic: تِشْرَب إِيه يَا بَاشَا قَهْوَة وَلَّا شَاي
arabic_plain: تشرب ايه يا باشا قهوة ولا شاي
translit: teshrab eh ya basha 2ahwa walla shay
tishrab eih ya basha ahwa wala shaay
translation_en: what would you like to drink boss, coffee or tea?

arabic: كُبَّايَة عَصِير مَانْجَة سَاقْعَة لَوْ سَمَحْت
arabic_plain: كباية عصير مانجة ساقعة لو سمحت
translation_en: a cold glass of mango juice, please

translit: el molokhiya dee ri7itha tifta7 en-nifs
translation_en: this molokhia smells appetizing

arabic: تِسْلَم إِيدِك يَا سِتّ الكُلّ عَلَى الأَكْل الحِلْو دَه
arabic_plain: تسلم إيدك يا ست الكل على الأكل الحلو ده
translit: teslam 2eedek ya sett el-koll 3ala el-2akl el-7elw da
tislam eedik ya sitt el kol 3ala el akl el 7ilw dah
translation_en: bless your hands, lady of all, for this delicious food
bon appetit to your heart
may God grant you joy, O Lord

arabic: أَنَا شَبْعَان خَالِص مِش قَادِر آكُل تَانِي
arabic_plain: أنا شبعان خالص مش قادر آكل تاني
translation_en: I am completely full, I can't eat any more

translit: enta shakhs mo7taram we kollak zoo2
inta sha5s mu7taram w kullak zo2
translation_en: you are a respectable person and full of courtesy
that is very kind of you, sir/ma'am
may I help you with any other service?
thank you very much, that is enough

arabic: العَفْو عَلَى إِيه إِحْنَا فِي الخِدْمَة
arabic_plain: العفو على ايه احنا في الخدمة
translation_en: you're welcome, don't mention it, we are at your service

arabic: الفِيلْم الجِدِيد دَه قِصِّتُه حِلْوَة أَوِي
arabic_plain: الفيلم الجديد ده قصته حلوة أوي
translit: el film el gedid dah 'isseto 7ilwa awi
translation_en: this new movie has a very nice story

translit: ta3ala niroo7 el sinima yom el 5amis
translation_en: come let's go to the cinema on Thursday
I booked the tickets online
hanging out with you all is something one never gets tired of
laughing from the heart lengthens life
this joke made me die laughing

arabic: إِنْتَ بْتِتْكَلِّم مَصْرِي أَحْسَن مِن المَصْرِيِّين
arabic_plain: انت بتتكلم مصري أحسن من المصريين
translit: inta btitkallim masry a7san min el masriyyin
translation_en: you speak Egyptian Arabic better than Egyptians!

translit: ana ba7eb el lahga el masreya giddan
translation_en: I love the Egyptian dialect very much

translit: el-lahga el-masreyya sahla we dammaha khafeef
el lahga el masreya sahla w damaha 5afeef
translation_en: the Egyptian dialect is easy and lighthearted

translit: maSr om el dunya w nasha tayebin
translation_en: Egypt is the mother of the world and its people are kind

arabic: الهَوَا عَلَى كُورْنِيش إِسْكَنْدَرِيَّة يِرُدّ الرُّوح
arabic_plain: الهوا على كورنيش إسكندرية يرد الروح
translit: el hawa 3ala kornish eskenderiya yirod el rooh
translation_en: the breeze on the Alexandria Corniche revives the soul

translit: esh-shams tal3a wel gaw gamil ennaharda
translation_en: the sun is out and the weather is beautiful today

arabic: المَطَر بِيِنْزِل فِي الشِّتَا فِي إِسْكَنْدَرِيَّة
arabic_plain: المطر بينزل في الشتا في إسكندرية
translit: el-matar beyenzel fi el-sheta fi eskendereyya
el matar biyinzil fel shita fi eskenderiya
translation_en: the rain falls in winter in Alexandria

arabic: خُد مَعَاك جَاكِيت عَشَان الجَوّ هَيِبْرَد
arabic_plain: خد معاك جاكيت عشان الجو هيبرد
translit: 5od ma3ak gaket ashan el gaw hayibrad
translation_en: take a jacket with you because the weather will get cold
where did you put the car keys?

translit: el mafati7 3ala el tarabeeza gowwa el ooda
translation_en: the keys are on the table inside the room

arabic: دَوَّرْت عَلِيهَا فِي كُلّ حِتَّة مَش لَاقِيهَا
arabic_plain: دورت عليها في كل حتة مش لاقيها
translation_en: I looked for it everywhere and can't find it

translit: aheh la'itha kanit ta7t el mi5adda
translation_en: there it is, I found it, it was under the pillow

arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّه إِنَّك لَقِيتْهَا قَبْل مَا نِنْزِل
arabic_plain: الحمد لله إنك لقيتها قبل ما ننزل
translation_en: thank God you found it before we went downstairs

translit: berra7a wenta saye' el tari2 za7ma
translation_en: take it easy while driving, the road is crowded
fasten your seatbelt, boss
the car needs to be washed and wiped down

translit: hafawil banzin min el ma7ata el gaya
translation_en: I'll fill up the tank with gas at the next station

arabic: إِيه رَأْيَك فِي القَمِيص الجِدِيد دَه
arabic_plain: ايه رأيك في القميص الجديد ده
translit: eh ra2yak fi el-2amees el-gedeed da
eih ra'yak fel 'amis el gedid dah
translation_en: what do you think of this new shirt?
very stylish and its color suits you

arabic: مَبْرُوك عَلِيك تِدَوِّبُه فِي عَرَق العَافْيَة
arabic_plain: مبروك عليك تذوبه في عرق العافية
translation_en: congratulations, may you wear it in good health

arabic: أَنَا بَأَذَاكِر عَشَان عَنْدِي إِمْتِحَان بُكْرَة
arabic_plain: أنا بأذاكر عشان عندي امتحان بكرة
translation_en: I am studying because I have an exam tomorrow

translit: rabbena yewaffa2ak we tenga7 be 2a3la el-daragat
rabbina yiwaffa'ak w tinga7 bi a3la ed-daragat
translation_en: may God grant you success and top grades
keep me in your prayers, my dear

arabic: إِن شَاء الله خِير مَا تِقْلَقْش خَالِص
arabic_plain: إن شاء الله خير ما تقلقش خالص
translit: en sha2 allah kheer ma te2la2sh khalis
translation_en: God willing all will be well, don't worry at all

translit: elly fih el kher yi2addimo rabbina
translation_en: whatever holds goodness, may our Lord bring it forth

translit: we ne3ma bellah koll shee2 benaseeb
w ni3ma billah kol she2 binaseeb
translation_en: indeed we trust in God, everything is by destiny
alright, see you in goodness (goodbye)

arabic: مَعَ السَّلَامَة خَلِّي بَالَك مِن الطَّرِيق
arabic_plain: مع السلامة خلي بالك من الطريق
translit: ma3a el-salama khalli balak men el-taree2
ma3a es-salama 5alli balak min el tari2
translation_en: goodbye, watch the road carefully
